Find out what is going on and fix it.

         return 0.0

+"""Regression: percent coupon must respect line quantity."""
+
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from checkout_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_percent_coupon_applies_to_quantity():
+    resp = client.post(
+        "/checkout/quote",
+        json={"lines": [{"sku": "LAMP-20", "qty": 2}, {"sku": "MUG-08", "qty": 1}], "coupon": "SAVE10"},
+    )
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    assert resp.json() == {"subtotal": 48.0, "discount": 4.8, "total": 43.2}

events.summary: Patch adds missing `line.qty` multiplier to percent coupon calculation, matching subtotal logic and fixing reported $2.80 vs $4.80 error. Reproduction with 2x LAMP-20 + 1x MUG-08 confirms root cause and explains single-item non-repro. No other discount paths affected and no new issues introduced.

hypotheses.note: Evidence chain is exact: screenshot math matches unit-only sum, code line 68 omits qty while line 81 includes it, and API reproduction with qty>1 fails before and passes after; single-qty case unaffected as expected.
